build_pipeline_stage: build a pipeline stage subclass that implements the forward method for diffusion processing
verify_input_batch: verify input batch data against stage requirements using verify_input and VerificationResult
run_stage_with_profiling: run a pipeline stage with automatic input/output verification and performance profiling
configure_stage_parallelism: configure stage parallelism type as replicated, main_rank_only, or cfg_parallel
load_offload_stage_model: load or offload a model for a pipeline stage using load_model and offload_model
